focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Experiments 主结果、消融归因与 Limitations 讨论（BP17–BP24）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 极端/反常情况与失败案例坦诚剖析段（Failure Case & Outlier Analysis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想通过可视化案例（Case Study / Qualitative Analysis），既展示模型在复杂跳变下的精准跟踪，又坦诚剖析一个模型预测失准的极端案例。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Experiments 第 4.5 节 Qualitative & Failure Case Analysis
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [定性对比切入 Qualitative Setup]：Figure 5 visualizes predicted trajectories during an abrupt regime shift on [Dataset/Task].
S2 [成功案例亮点 Success Highlight]：While [Baseline] lags behind the sudden step change by [K steps] and overshoots, our model rapidly locks onto the new amplitude regime within [M steps].

S3 [失败案例坦诚剖析 Honest Failure Mode]：Nevertheless, inspecting the bottom-right failure case reveals that when an external manual override occurs without historical precursors, all purely endogenous forecasters—including ours—exhibit a transient lag.
S4 [改进启示 Constructive Takeaway]：Incorporating exogenous event logs or textual maintenance records is necessary to anticipate such unscheduled interventions.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Visual Setup -> Success under Shift -> Honest Failure Case under Unobserved Exogenous Shock -> Actionable Insight. 绑定逻辑规则：L017, L018.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Figure 5 shows that our prediction curve is very close to the ground truth curve, while baseline curves are far away. Sometimes our model also makes small errors when the data changes too suddenly.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 只说 very close / far away，没有指出具体的滞后（phase lag）、超调（overshoot）以及外生干预（exogenous shock）的物理本质。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Figure 5 visualizes 336-step forecasts during an abrupt voltage drop on the ETTm1 transformer load benchmark. Whereas PatchTST and iTransformer exhibit a 14-step phase lag and severe post-recovery overshoot, DyTS-Net tracks both the sharp downward ramp and subsequent stabilization within 5% amplitude error. Nevertheless, the failure case in Panel (d) reveals that when an unscheduled manual grid curtailment occurs without preceding spectral precursors, our endogenous model experiences a 6-step delayed response. Anticipating such zero-precursor manual interventions requires integrating exogenous dispatch logs alongside historical telemetry.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 议论文破题首段：具象趋势锚定 + 争议张力 + 明确中心论点（Zero-Template Hook & Thesis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL Independent Essay 首段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [具象现象锚定 Concrete Trend Anchor]：直接从具体技术变革或制度调整切入（如 Generative AI tools now draft code and summarize literature across university campuses），绝不用 With the development of...。
S2 [核心争议张力 Core Tension / Debate]：While proponents argue that [View A: efficiency/accessibility], critics warn that [View B: skill erosion/inequality].

S3 [带条件的中心论点 Nuanced Thesis Statement]：In my view, rather than banning [X] outright or adopting it uncritically, [Institution/Society] should [Core Stance], because [Primary Reason 1] and [Primary Reason 2].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Concrete Phenomenon (No Cliché) -> Balanced Tension -> Conditional & Specific Thesis Statement. 绑定逻辑规则：L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: With the rapid development of science and technology, artificial intelligence is becoming more and more popular in universities. Some people think it is good, while others think it is bad. In my opinion, every coin has two sides and we should use it properly.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 汇集了中国考生三大扣分重灾区：① With the rapid development of...；② more and more popular / good vs. bad；③ Every coin has two sides（零立场的废话中心论点）。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Large language models and automated code assistants have rapidly become routine study aids across university campuses. While proponents contend that these tools accelerate literature synthesis and lower programming barriers, critics warn that unchecked reliance erodes students' capacity for independent problem formulation. In my view, universities should integrate generative tools into advanced coursework only after students master foundational analytical skills, as premature delegation weakens debugging competence and obscures underlying mathematical principles.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 针对“创新性存疑（Limited Novelty / Incremental）”的有力澄清段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Clarify Distinction -> Explain Why Naive Stacking Fails -> Highlight Core Coupling Mechanism -> Prove with 'Naive A+B' Ablation Data. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L016.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: We disagree that our paper lacks novelty. Although A and B existed before, nobody used them together on time series forecasting. Also our results are very good, so our paper is novel.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 承认了“只是把现成的 A 和 B 第一次拿到这个任务上拼起来（nobody used them together）”，等于坐实了審稿人的 A+B 拼凑指控！
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We appreciate the opportunity to clarify how our architecture differs fundamentally from a naive combination of spectral filtering and neural ODEs. Directly stacking an FFT block with a standard neural ODE fails under abrupt regime shifts because spectral normalization strips the exact boundary values required to initialize the ODE trajectory. Our core technical innovation lies in the bidirectional phase-scale coupling operator (Eq. 7), which uses instantaneous spectral entropy to gate ODE stiffness while feeding predicted scale bounds back to regularize frequency attention. To verify this empirically, we implemented a direct `Naive FFT + ODE` concatenation baseline in Table R2 below: our coupled formulation reduces 720-step MSE by 15.2% over `Naive FFT + ODE`, confirming that the gain stems from our mathematical coupling rather than module stacking.

focal_logic_rules.category: Exam Essays (六级/雅思/托福论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 具象微观场景举例法：用一句话精确案例终结空洞模板（Micro-Case Grounding）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 六级/雅思/托福作文严禁编造虚假的调查数据（如 *A recent survey by Harvard shows 87.3% of people...*），也严禁写空洞口号（*For example, technology helps doctors a lot*）。最高分做法是用一句 `For instance, when [Specific Actor] implements [Specific Tool/Policy] in [Specific Scenario], [Concrete Measurable Effect]` 构建具象行业微观切片。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: For instance, when [municipal grid operators / radiology departments / logistics warehouses] deploy [specific technology/policy], they can [concrete operational improvement], thereby [link back to paragraph claim].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 举例要么假大空（For example, Jack studied hard and succeeded），要么编造一眼假的统计数字。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: For example, according to a recent survey, 92% of factories that use robots become very rich and successful.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: For instance, when automotive assembly plants deploy collaborative robots for repetitive welding and heavy chassis lifting, human technicians can transition toward quality inspection and fault diagnostics, reducing workplace musculoskeletal injuries while raising line throughput.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 不编造假百分比，而是通过“汽车总装厂部署协作机器人承担重复焊接与底盘搬运 -> 技工转向质检与故障诊断 -> 减少工伤并提升产线吞吐量”展现母语级具体说服力。

focal_logic_rules.category: Style & Anti-AI-ese (去 AI 化文风)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 篇章级去 AI 味手术：砍掉空洞修辞外壳，直奔命题内核（Zero AI-ese Discourse Surgery）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Stripping LLM Rhetorical Padding at the Paragraph Level
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 大模型生成的段落有三大典型臭味：① 句首喜欢戴高帽（In the rapidly evolving landscape of... / It serves as a testament to...）；② 段中喜欢滥用排比与抽象隐喻（not only... but also..., tapestry, beacon, realm, paradigm shift, delve into, underscore）；③ 段尾喜欢升华口号（paving the way for a brighter future）。修改时必须一刀砍掉所有修辞外壳，首句第一词直接落到具体研究对象或议题实体上。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Delete: 'In the realm of X, it is undeniable that Y plays a pivotal role in spearheading Z.' -> Write: '[Concrete Entity Y] governs [Specific Mechanism Z] by [Measurable Action].'
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 误以为辞藻越华丽、排比越工整、抽象大词越多，英语就越高级。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: In the rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence, time series forecasting stands as a cornerstone that plays a pivotal role in spearheading industrial transformation, serving as a testament to data-driven decision-making.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Accurate multi-horizon time series forecasting enables power grid operators to balance renewable generation against fluctuating consumer demand.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 砍掉 32 个词的 AI 废话外壳，用 16 个词的紧凑主谓宾直接锁定“多步时间序列预测帮电网调度员平衡新能源发电与负荷波动”。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 多模态灵巧操作与力触觉闭环反馈
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想通过可视化案例（Case Study / Qualitative Analysis），既展示模型在复杂跳变下的精准跟踪，又坦诚剖析一个模型预测失准的极端案例。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Figure 5 shows that our prediction curve is very close to the ground truth curve, while baseline curves are far away. Sometimes our model also makes small errors when the data changes too suddenly.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L021 具象微观场景举例法：用一句话精确案例终结空洞模板（Micro-Case Grounding））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 只说 very close / far away，没有指出具体的滞后（phase lag）、超调（overshoot）以及外生干预（exogenous shock）的物理本质。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Figure 5 visualizes 336-step forecasts during an abrupt voltage drop on the ETTm1 transformer load benchmark. Whereas PatchTST and iTransformer exhibit a 14-step phase lag and severe post-recovery overshoot, DyTS-Net tracks both the sharp downward ramp and subsequent stabilization within 5% amplitude error. Nevertheless, the failure case in Panel (d) reveals that when an unscheduled manual grid curtailment occurs without preceding spectral precursors, our endogenous model experiences a 6-step delayed response. Anticipating such zero-precursor manual interventions requires integrating exogenous dispatch logs alongside historical telemetry.

Standard Transformer forecasters look accurate during calm weather, yet why do their predictions lag by hours right when the storm hits? The culprit is instance normalization: in trying to stabilize attention weights, it strips away the exact amplitude surges needed to predict peak loads. In the next five minutes, I will show how our model, DyTS-Net, resolves this trade-off—cutting extreme-weather forecasting error by 17% while running twice as fast.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Consider a multivariate time series $\mathbf{X}_{1:L} = [x_1, \dots, x_L]^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$ recording $C$ correlated sensors over lookback horizon $L$. Given an binary observation mask $\mathbf{M} \in \{0, 1\}^{L \times C}$ indicating irregular sensor dropouts, our objective is to learn a generative mapping $p_\theta(\mathbf{Y}_{L+1:L+H} \mid \mathbf{X}_{1:L} \odot \mathbf{M})$ over future horizon $H$. Crucially, unlike standard settings that assume time-invariant marginal distributions, we explicitly account for non-stationary regime shifts where $\mathbb{E}[x_t]$ and $\text{Cov}(x_t)$ evolve continuously between the lookback and forecasting windows.
